updates.scope_and_remaining_work: The proved PID torsion theorem is now instantiated on the actual polynomial action of every finite-dimensional operator. A finite product of positive irreducible-power quotients is constructed, including nonlinear factors. Zero summands are removed by an explicit equivalence. Identification of grouped factors with the printed intrinsic primary submodules, and the generic pre-existing polynomial-module interface, are not yet supplied.

The actual arbitrary-field operator now constructs its positive primary decomposition. CRT gives generators and literal residue-field quotient maps give the matching lower bounds, proving canonical seed rank equals the largest irreducible-primary block count. This maximum is independent of the presentation. Still required at the exact printed scope: identify the grouped summands with intrinsic X_p and prove that the kernel of the residue map is p(T)X_p, thereby identifying each count with dim over k[t]/(p) of X_p/p(T)X_p. A surjective factor map is not silently treated as that kernel/quotient identification.

Complete at the displayed conditional scope: an actual polynomial-module equivalence to the finite product of nonconstant factors and their divisibility chain imply least seed number, natural seed rank and cardinal seed rank equal the factor count. The theorem also handles the empty product. Finite products and finite direct sums represent the same finite decomposition. Existence of an ordered invariant-factor presentation is not asserted by this declaration, and is not an additional hypothesis-free claim of the printed conditional corollary.

The arbitrary-field primary-block-count formula is now proved, and the self-adjoint intrinsic eigenspace formula is preserved. Remaining: convert the primary counts for linear irreducibles into intrinsic eigenspace dimensions for arbitrary non-diagonalizable operators over an algebraically closed field. No scalar-extension or Jordan-count identification is claimed yet.

The arbitrary-field cyclic/minpoly bridge remains proved. Every actual positive primary presentation is now proved cyclic exactly when its irreducible principal-ideal labels are injective, with no conclusion hidden in the presentation structure. The invariant-factor count is proved given the displayed nonconstant chain. Still required for the full six-way printed criterion: literal intrinsic-primary interpretation, assembly of the rational-canonical clauses and the algebraic-closure scalar-extension/eigenspace clause.
